name: Procurement Review Desk
description: Normalizes approved supplier quotes and prepares a traceable commercial comparison, risk register, and owner decision packet without contacting suppliers or placing orders.

intake.description: Approved quote evidence, required specifications, commercial terms, comparison rules, currency assumptions, constraints, and known gaps.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Inventory suppliers, quote versions, line items, currencies, taxes, validity dates, specifications, delivery terms, and missing evidence without silent assumptions.

roles.title: Commercial Analyst
roles.goal: Normalize comparable terms, calculate only supported totals and variances, check specification coverage, and explain material trade-offs with source references.

roles.title: Procurement Reviewer
roles.goal: Build the exception and risk register, decision options, clarification questions, and owner approval packet without selecting or contacting a supplier.

output_contract.description: A source-traced quote comparison and owner decision packet with no supplier contact or purchasing action.
